sourceLimits: Current HEROES_DB portrait and production.audiovisual.portrait agree: one original-project V2 internal authority, not an external franchise reference.
One portrait leaves reverse cloak/quiver construction, tiny leaf carvings and exact hidden straps uncertain; do not certify perfect1:1 or independent hidden geometry.
Valedor settings are original fantasy compositions consistent with ancient forests, rune magic, castles and the broken crown conflict; no scene is claimed to be an official screenshot.
CG05 is a Nexus gameplay adaptation;09-11FanArt;12-15WhatIf, with one transformation13 and one temporal variant15. Apparent age remains source adult-presenting without numerical assertion.
Old atlas actually viewed: green cape but white tunic and no bow/quiver/leaf armor, visibly divergent and preserved as historical variant.
